query: INSERT INTO user_preferences (user_id, theme, locale, timezone, currency, palette_shortcut, search_contexts, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET theme = EXCLUDED.theme, locale = EXCLUDED.locale, timezone = EXCLUDED.timezone, currency = EXCLUDED.currency, palette_shortcut = EXCLUDED.palette_shortcut, search_contexts = EXCLUDED.search_contexts, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
